statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0543 is an informational notice that the chrono crate is unmaintained. It names no vulnerability and no patched release. chrono 0.4.42 is a direct dependency of flux-core and is compiled into libflux. Replacing it needs a change in flux, the Flux query engine that Kapacitor links as libflux.
